name: Chikan-san Taiken Tour ~Pool Hen~
original_name: 痴漢さん体験ツアー～プール編～
source:
You received a invitation letter for a one-day tour where you can be a one-day molester.
This time, it takes place in pool!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE030666.html]DLSite English[/url]]

這次，是在泳池裡進行的！
